new_this_week.title: The Boroughs
new_this_week.about: Eight-episode sci-fi/horror executive-produced by the Duffer Brothers (Stranger Things). In a picturesque retirement community, an unlikely band of heroes — Geena Davis, Alfred Molina, Bill Pullman, Alfre Woodard, Clarke Peters, Denis O'Hare, Jena Malone, Carlos Miranda — face an otherworldly threat that's stealing their time. Created by Jeffrey Addiss and Will Matthews; Ben Taylor directs and EPs.
new_this_week.why: Sci-fi + supernatural + ensemble + Stranger Things pedigree is a direct match on multiple signals. Most-anticipated new series of the week behind The Boys finale. Thursday tentpole.

new_this_week.about: Episode 5 of the 10-episode small-town supernatural mystery from Katie Dippold (Parks and Rec writer) with Hiro Murai directing. Critic score sitting near 97% RT.
new_this_week.why: Pinned + you just rated Ep 4 4⭐. Stay-current pick for midweek bedtime — same slot as last week.

new_this_week.title: Your Friends & Neighbors S2 — Ep 8 'I Feel Lost Without Me'
new_this_week.date: Thu May 21 (9pm ET) / Fri May 22, 2026 — 4 DAYS OUT

new_this_week.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
new_this_week.about: Tatiana Maslany leads a darkly comedic thriller as newly divorced mom Paula, falling into blackmail, murder, and youth-soccer politics after convincing herself she witnessed a crime. Created by David J. Rosen, directed/EP'd by David Gordon Green. 10 eps weekly through Jul 15. Two-ep premiere drops at midnight.
new_this_week.why: Dark comedy + 30-min eps + strong ensemble lead lines up with your Fleabag / Solar Opposites / Slow Horses shelf. Maslany is a credibility anchor.

new_this_week.title: Nope (2022)
new_this_week.about: Jordan Peele's 2022 sci-fi/horror: OJ and Emerald Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya, Keke Palmer) run a horse ranch in Agua Dulce, CA, and discover something hovering above it. 83% RT, $171M global on a $68M budget. Leaves Peacock and lands on Netflix exclusively for ~10 months.
new_this_week.why: Two top-2 genres in one (sci-fi + horror/suspense). Peele = plot twists that pay off, elevated horror with substance underneath — your hit signal. Newly available tomorrow on a platform you're on.

new_this_week.title: Devil May Cry S2
new_this_week.about: Adi Shankar's adult-animation series. S2 launches the Dante–Vergil rivalry. S1 hit 96% RT critic in 2025; S2 trailers have been well-received. Shankar has compared S2's scope to 'Batman Begins → The Dark Knight.'
new_this_week.why: Adult animation + supernatural + 30-min eps = same shelf as Solar Opposites. The highest-rated drop now sitting on your platforms for binge-mode.

new_this_week.title: Black Phone 2
new_this_week.about: Scott Derrickson directs the sequel to 2021's The Black Phone. Finney (Mason Thames) and Gwen (Madeleine McGraw) face The Grabber (Ethan Hawke) again — this time through dreams. Adapts a Joe Hill short story. 72% RT critic / 82% audience; $132M box office. R-rated.
new_this_week.why: Horror/suspense is in your top-4 genre stack. Just dropped yesterday — fits the bedtime horror slot if you want a Sat-night alt to a Demon Slayer block.

new_this_week.why: Watchlist title still sitting after a month — Schwartzman + Plaza + John Waters is your off-beat shelf. Bedtime-friendly 30-min eps.

new_this_week.title: Unconditional
new_this_week.date: Streaming weekly since Fri May 8, 2026 (4 eps out, weekly through Jun 19)

new_this_week.about: Jack Thorne's 4-part adaptation of Golding's novel, directed by Marc Munden. 95% RT critic. IMDB 6.7 — audience gap. Critic complaints include a 'distracting' fisheye lens.
new_this_week.why: Try, not strong. Book adaptation + 4-ep run is your signal, but the audience score gap and stylization risk make Ep 1 a probe, not a commitment.

new_this_week.title: Mating Season
new_this_week.about: From the Big Mouth creative team (Nick Kroll, Mark Levin, Jennifer Flackett, Andrew Goldberg). Anthropomorphic forest critters — a bear named Josh (Zach Woods) and a raccoon named Ray (Kroll) — navigate mating-season hookups. 6-ep first season.
new_this_week.why: Adult animation + ~25-min eps is your shelf on paper. Try-flag — Big Mouth's juvenile-leaning humor is on your miss-signal list ('juvenile/kiddy humor'). One-episode probe to see whether it skews adult-witty or kid-raunchy.

new_this_week.about: Live-action Marvel Spider-Man Noir. Nic Cage plays Ben Reilly — an older, down-on-his-luck PI in 1930s New York forced back into the cowl. 8 eps. Released in both 'Authentic Black and White' and 'True-Hue' full-color versions.
new_this_week.why: RT flagged it as #1 most-anticipated TV of May. Period noir + Cage is a distinctive swing — high-variance try. Mark for next week.

Alt-history space race told from the Soviet side — cosmonauts, engineers, intelligence officers in Star City. Cast headlined by Rhys Ifans with Agnes O'Casey and Anna Maxwell-Martin. Two-ep premiere May 29, then weekly through Jul 10.
new_this_week.why: Sci-fi (your #1 genre) + alt-history + world-building stack — Foundation/Severance-adjacent prestige sci-fi shelf. Mark for May 29 dive.
